parent_tactic.name: Lateral Movement
parent_tactic.description: The adversary is trying to move through your environment.

technique.name: Constellation Hopping via Crosslink
technique.description: Adversaries may traverse between spacecraft in a constellation using inter-satellite links (crosslinks).
knowledge_from_urls: Constellation hopping allows an attacker to move from a compromised satellite to others in the same network using crosslinks.

related_control.name: Ccache Files
related_control.description: Adversaries may use ccache files to compromise boot memory or other persistent storage.

cases.source_text: Constellation hopping allows an attacker to move from a compromised satellite to others in the same network using crosslinks. Inter-satellite links are critical infrastructure. Adversaries may use ccache files to compromise boot memory or other persistent storage, potentially enabling lateral movement if these files are shared across the constellation.
